title: Our type faces and guidelines
slide_intent: Teach designers how type roles make a page easy to scan, and where expressive lettering can give way to ordinary reading forms.
strategic_value: Voltera can retain the open A in a product signature while keeping product names easy to read in running text.
demonstration: Three specimen rows connect Lato Bold, Lato Semibold and Inter Regular to their roles. Three NOVA specimens below compare the A with and without its crossbar.
practical_value: Use Lato for titles and subheads and Inter for body text. Reserve the custom open-A treatment for designed product-name instances such as a logo or hero.

content_islands.name: Contents rail and folio
content_islands.spec: Place the dark contents rail on the left. Highlight the current topic in blue and mark page 12 in a blue tab at lower right.

content_islands.name: Typeface-to-role scale
content_islands.spec: Show each typeface and its tracking and line-height guidance on the left, joining it to a specimen on the right. Use 120% line height for titles and subheads and 140–160% for body copy.

content_islands.name: A-bar comparison
content_islands.spec: Place a short explanation beneath the scale. Show NOVA in the Voltera, Lato and Inter faces on one line so the letterform change is visible.
